title: Guided Request Chronicle: Breadcrumbs, Span Focus & Correlation Pivot
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a guided request drilldown workspace that surfaces a breadcrumbed navigation path, span-level focus panel, and a correlation pivot to discover related traces by correlation IDs or attributes. Goal is to enable engineers to quickly locate root causes, jump between service-level contexts, and build reproducible investigation snapshots.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Kickoff: Reviewed goals with PM and Eng. Primary constraints: render up to 2k spans in a single view, maintain 60fps interactions for timeline scrubbing, and preserve keyboard-first navigation for accessibility. Agreed to prioritize progressive hydration and canvas-level rendering for large traces.

2026-03-11 - Early prototype (v0): Introduced breadcrumb trail that encodes service > request route > correlation-id > selected span. Feedback from Eng: breadcrumb items must be copyable and deep-linkable (shareable URLs). Added small chevrons and hover tooltips for ID copy.

2026-03-11 - Research note: User interviews (n=6 SREs/Platform Eng) indicated the common workflow: identify high-latency span, expand sibling spans, then pivot to other traces with same correlation-id. Designed 'Correlation Pivot' panel to show top 20 related traces with sampling heatmap and quick-jump.

2026-03-12 - Review with PM Marco Liu: PM requested a persistent 'analysis snapshot' export (JSON/CSV) that captures current filters and focused span for incident handoff. Added acceptance criteria item for snapshot export and shareable deep-link.

2026-03-13 - Engineering review with ENG-42012 owners: Discussed implementation trade-offs. Eng prefers incremental rendering + webgl canvas for the span timeline. Agreed on API changes: include per-span metadata for operation tags and service affinity to enable grouping client-side.

2026-03-13 - Design critique: Iterated on span grouping visuals — introduced operation chips (read/write/compute) and a minimap overview to allow quick vertical navigation. Accessibility review requested high-contrast color tokens and ARIA labels for the timeline scrubber.

2026-03-14 - UX polish pass: Finalized hover affordances (latency breakdown tooltip, blame sources), keyboard shortcuts (f = focus span, g = open correlation pivot, / = quick filter), and microcopy. Preparing Handoff packet for devs and QA.

2026-03-14 - Next steps: Create figma handoff frames, add storybook components for breadcrumb and correlation pivot, file ENG tickets for rendering optimizations and backend sampling endpoints. Schedule a follow-up design-dev sync on 2026-03-18.
decisions: Keep breadcrumb as canonical navigation (service > route > correlation > span). Breadcrumb nodes are deep-linkable and copyable.
Introduce Correlation Pivot: a right-rail panel listing related traces by correlation-id and top-k sibling traces with a small heatmap view.
Use canvas-based rendering for the timeline to support thousands of spans; DOM-only rendering reserved for focused span list to keep accessibility semantics.
Provide analysis snapshot export (JSON + CSV) capturing current filters and focused span for incident handoff.
Color-code spans by 'latency contributor' (network, database, compute) with high-contrast tokens and legend in header for accessibility.
Keyboard-first interactions and ARIA roles for timeline, minimap, and breadcrumbs to meet WCAG navigation needs.
Limit initial correlation pivot to 20 related traces with an option to 'Load more' to protect backend sampling and UI performance.
Expose telemetry events: trace_open, span_focus, correlation_pivot_open to monitor feature adoption and pivot-to-trace rates.
acceptance_criteria: Breadcrumb trail visible on trace view with deep-link URL reflecting selected breadcrumb node.
Span focus panel displays span metadata, latency breakdown, tags, and links to related logs and metrics.
Correlation Pivot lists top 20 related traces and allows jump-to-trace without a full page refresh.
Timeline supports keyboard navigation, tooltip on hover, and a minimap for quick vertical scrubbing.
Analysis snapshot export captures filters, breadcrumb state, focused span id, and timestamp range; export validated by QA.
Design tokens conform to accessibility contrast ratios; accessibility checklist signed off by QA.
Performance: trace views with up to 2k spans render interactive timeline within 1.5s on staging normal hardware and maintain interactive dragging at >=30fps.
Storybook components created for Breadcrumb, Span Focus Panel, and Correlation Pivot with unit tests.
